1.consolidated_definition: Disfrutar intensamente algo, o sacarle provecho La fanaticada de Abba puede darse banquete, porque la orquesta de 10 músicos y 10 coristas, dirigida por Carlos Cruz, recrea junto al elenco gran parte de los temas más populares de la famosa agrupación. (Primera Hora, 25-10-18)
1.en_consolidated_definition: To thoroughly enjoy something or derive benefit from it. The Abba fanatics can indulge themselves because the 10-piece orchestra and 10-voice choir, directed by Carlos Cruz, recreates alongside the cast a significant portion of the most popular themes from the famous group.
